stage1.impression: A terraced red-orange acrylic pendant hangs in the top third of a flat, evenly lit grey room over a pale wood table with a plate of pears. The light is soft and directionless, with no sun patch, no cast shadow and no coloured light, and a hard white window reflection cuts off the left third of the dome, so the frame looks like a clean draft rather than a hero.

blocking_9: Sunlight visibly passes through the dome and lands as a coloured pool with the window frame's shadow in frame
A real light-to-shade ratio (the wall spans only 160.9 to 189.6)
The polished ring edges read as bright glowing lines
No hard vertical white veil on the left third of the dome
The props do not compete with the lamp
